reviews.text: 挺有特点的增量游戏，流程稍短，就是不知道为什么很难集中注意力一直玩，每次上线砸一把就力竭了，可能反馈还不够足吧。
好玩，爽！但是流程有点短，2.9小时全成就了（甚至来得及退款
托哥还是义气，大几千万的贷款一个电话就放了。 画面和打击感不错；缺点是天赋对赚钱速度的提升很不明确，每次交账单时的三选一天赋也很神秘 游戏流程很短
好玩，砸存钱罐很爽（木头之类的其他材质的存钱罐大部分砸的视觉反馈和音效不如陶制爽，但是那些材料确实是那样的也没办法），就是账单的三选一升级不能在一局游戏内集齐有点遗憾。
游戏非常好玩，但是完全不够玩四个小时就已经解锁全部成就了，希望作者多更新一点。
三个小时就通关了，最后那个大boss出来的时候还很激动，以为要解锁新的章节了，结果你告诉我结束了？！！
对于一个休闲放松类游戏的话，这个是一个十分不错的游戏，缺点的话就是玩法单一，通关后，后续再玩会感到无聊，玩着没新意，所以希望可以多出一些玩法，增加游戏的趣味性
虽然4个小时就全成就通关，但比较上头，期待后续新内容。
一百分钟通关还能退款 好游戏 打折再买回来 哈哈哈
简单的爽游 后期最好加个自动锁头 感觉还是不够爽，针对于没有自动锁头还是需要自己瞄准，希望更全屏的攻击
10/10 Fun idle game! Can’t wait for more updates to the game or another game soon!

Neat and fun. I don't generally like incremental games that ramp into millions etc. but this one does it right and doesn't overstay its welcome once it reaches that point. Good little game to toss a few bucks at and brain-off for a bit, reasonable to get all achievements. SFX and VFX scratch a nice itch. I beat it on my 3rd "cycle" with some luck, can't imagine it taking 6 or more. So don't get discouraged if you miss a bill by a hair or throw a little bit on the gamba.

I heard about this game on social media about how someone had stolen all of their asset's before their official release and made into a mobile game with paid boost's and how it had a couple hundred thousand download's already before they had found out! Crazy how that happened but luckily they got that dupe taken down and when I seen it had officially released on steam I knew I had to support! My mom also loves pigs she has a huge pig collection around the house and even thought this game was great! So far I've played a few hour's and honestly can say it's worth the purchase and is very enjoyable to smash the pigs you unlock. There is a lot to the game and I haven't even gotten to half of it yet and can tell I will very much enjoy this game till the end! 10/10
Short, cute, and fun. Doesn't overstay it's welcome even when aiming for 100% achievements.
Took me about 6 hours to fully complete and get all the achievements def worth the price it was lots of fun!

[i][b] Bills Must Be Paid [/b][/i] takes the tedious mouse clicking out of what is in a lot of incremental games and replaces it with a satisfying hammer holding hand that does all the hard work for you. Smashing your way through hundreds of piggy banks to pay your bills with some relaxing tunes playing in the background makes for a lovely time waster. Though 100% completing the game is very quick and offers not much incentive to continue playing after, if you are an achievement hunter or even a fan of incremental games, it's worth picking up. [b] For a simple incremental game, I'd give it an 8/10 though lack of replayability dips it down to a 7.5/10. [/b]
bit pricey for a total completion time of 3.5h. nice grpahics and fun gameplay tho. 3.5/5

Very fun to play with a good feedback loop and permanent progression after a run ends. The main complaint I would have is the length. I beat the entirety of the game with 100% achievements in about 4 cycles and 4 hours total.
Great game for a great price. Relaxing and strategic at the same time. There are so many ways to play it.

Very super duper good, Took me 13 hours to complete at a relaxed pace, did not mind the price, however I think $7.50 aud would be a better fit. Does not take forever to achieve progress however also does not make it too easy to gain progress. Super duper good balance keeping you intrigued in the game and not instantly completing it. I would rate higher however as I have completed the game, there is no incentive to continue playing. 8/10 DEVS: Make new sort of level please. After completing the first one go to a new setting (new desk, backround and stuff) and bring new pigs new skills and stuff. For me
引入多周目本来对于增量游戏就是取巧的设计，该游戏甚至选择新游戏居然不是初始当前周末，而是类似删除存档功能初始化到一周目，无论这是设计失误还是故意为之，都是非常糟糕的，让玩家被动体验初始阶段都是掩盖后续增量设计的不足，无意发现该问题使人瞬间丧失了继续游玩的兴趣。

数值用脚填的幽默游戏，建议对数字不敏感的人游玩。本质跟枪小练习，喜欢运营的玩家谨慎购买 二编：恶意的拖长时间和毫无意义的技能树，整个游戏的本质就是买锤子砸猪，数量级的增张仅和猪解锁进度有关，支付账单后的三选一每个对金币获取的帮助都不超过1%（除了复利，怀疑设计数值的人没有经历过义务教育，我是认真的），用脚都填不出这样恶心人的数值，技能树更是如此，这样的冗余设计在我眼里除了恶心人和恶意拖延退款时间外毫无意义，本人游玩时间不超过2小时，已严肃退款，认真差评，以告后人。
游戏很短，三个小时左右就能结束，，想长期游玩不是很适合 缺点是新鲜感一过很容易腻

我最不喜欢玩一段视频强迫我重生然后从0开始，这个游戏就是，越到后面要求付的账单就越贵，直接从400万翻倍到700万，我一把才赚20多万，还要升级各个技能，没办法只能拿绿色那个刷金币，那绿色的三只猪游戏就不是人玩的，只能拿用手机录视频然后慢放，但是即使是慢放也很累眼睛，并且刷一次还不够，至少刷3次才够你这次的费用，但是下次700万就会变成上千万，一把20万，你下次还要刷金币，没钱你就要重生重新开始，无聊得要死。
不推荐，建议作者调整数值，局外成长和局内成长的数值给的相当保守，导致每一次开始捶打都感觉到煎熬，特别是后期需要刷钱的时候。 优化数值之前，不推荐，煎熬，体会不到玩几局就有成长的感觉。
可能制作组本意是劝人远离赌博吧，我越玩越痛苦，除了刚开始玩的一小时，后面就只有重复劳动的枯燥和无论如何也还不上钱的挫败感，一点爽感和正反馈也没有，一只一只死猪挑衅一般的蹦来蹦去，看到它们我就恶心
爽点全在击打效果上，增量的数值爽感几乎没有，两三小时打了大概一半的进度就腻了。 ps：轻薄本玩这个差点没烫死我TT
可玩性太低了，2小时够全成就加体验完所有内容了，而且后期成长点满以后反而爽不起来是最搞的，开局一锤子清屏然后只能打一个出一个在那边打地鼠
很失败的增量游戏 作为一个增量游戏，在第二周目，全局升级只点了两个最便宜的情况下，就可以通关 通关之后给的东西直接就够把所有全局升级点满还有很多剩余 不信邪的我又开了第三周目，但是体验相比于前两周目也没有任何明显提升

It's okay. Progression did not feel satisfying, and there's a mid-game lull where you're just not really making any progress until you break through a money or prestige wall. Didn't hate it, but I don't think I'd suggest it to someone either. Expensive compared to similar games.

Okay, I felt compelled to write a serious review for the first time in a while to comment on how I feel about an experience like this. First things first: this is a fun game. When you get started, you feel pretty satisfied by the progression as it is first presented to you. Smashing piggies is cathartic, and your hamster brain goes clicky click as you get the coins. You'll find that you'll run out of the ability to progress pretty quickly in the first run. In the second run, you go significantly farther, and get introduced to Tony. About 2/3 of the way through the game, you'll borrow from him, and you'll never have the ability to pay it back. And this is the only time you'll ever have interaction with that part of the game. Because once you get to the third run, the game breaks wide open and it is nearly impossible to lose. I do not consider myself some god gamer or anything, but this was by far one of the easiest games I've ever been able to platinum because so long as you are not braindead, you WILL platinum the game. And this is where I find some of the game's flaws in raw form. Because you'll get to the end, and come across the end game, which presents you with 12 more upgrades and King Piggy. These upgrades mean absolutely nothing. I spent the bulk of my time in the 3rd run getting money so I can buy upgrades that I will never use. And I destroyed King Piggy the first go. Once you do that, you'll buy all of the rings and then start a new game to literally get money from Tony so you can pay him back with the 300 or so you'll get from the first few piggies JUST so that you can strike that last achievement off the list. And...that's it. I will never play this game again. I know the devs called it a "small" game but I am pretty shocked to find it THAT small. Listen, this game is cute and it's a nice distraction. I would call the justification of 5+ dollars a stretch though when you consider the devs have no idea how to pace their progression system.

It's a fun incremental game that generally feels good but I 100%ed it in my playtime and see zero replay value so I can't recommend it at full price. If you see it around 2€, do go for it, otherwise wait for the sale.

Ok for a few hours but no reason to play any longer, the game is that short. Other incremental games that I've played recently cost half as much and have much more satisfying gameplay / progression so pretty disappointed in this one

Not sure if this game is worth it. Its engine is great, like performance is there.... But the game is too short for what it is. I 100% all achievements on my third run, there wasn't any challenge to it. You can easily buy every upgrade and skip right over different hammer upgrades and just brute force without even thinking about what the skills are even for. Its a very well polished game and I enjoyed the 5 hours played but I wouldn't get this game unless it was 50% off.

The first like 30 minutes are great but idk it has the flaws that all these idle games with skill trees do, at some point you stop reading them and just buy the cheapest upgrades until you win. It took me under 4 hours for all achievements and the last 3 hours were not particularly fun at all. I just dont feel like I'm really making any meaningful choices with the progression and all the abilities in the skill tree just turn your screen into screen shake particle spam which just isnt very interesting. for the price its fine i suppose but man idk i'd rather play something else
The game itself is pretty good but needing 4 hours for 100% Achievements is a bit to short or the pricetag is a bit to high. For what it is, its a very solid game, just to expensive for the size.

Cute presentation, satisfying piggy-bank smashing, and a promising skill tree made a good first impression, but the game’s core mechanic is far more demanding than an incremental game suggests. Unusable controller support, twitchy pigs, tiny hit zones, and automatic hammer timing made progress frustratingly difficult (especially for players with motor or aiming difficulties), while the harsh timers added more stress. I couldn’t get far enough to see whether the deeper progression was worthwhile, so I ultimately can't recommend it. +++ Music, animations, sound effects, and visual design are cute and work well. I enjoyed the process of actually destroying the piggy banks. It was satisfying when it worked. ++ Skill tree seems well thought out and interesting. It's not a simple tree you just buy everything; there's strategic thought involved. -- Controller support is unusable, though it advertises as supporting controller. There is no way in hell you will ever smash any pig with that unweildy acceleration and inaccurate control. --- For context, I have a motor disability. Even with mouse, actually hitting the pigs requires aimlabs training. I was unable to progress properly due to skill issue, which is not what I expected going into an incremental game. The little pigs sprint around like they're on crack; actually nailing one takes significant effort and attention. This is due to the timing aspect of the hammer hits (it's automatic, not controlled by you), the speed and unpredictability of the pigs, and the small hit zone of your hammer. You also have to hit the same pig multiple times, up to 12 times, to destroy it. This was frustrating and difficult for me. After an hour, I've made very little progress and been "bankrupted" multiple times, which is the game forcing a prestige due to being unable to pay the bills. --- There is a harsh and unforgiving run timer, and a looming overarching bill deadline, which will involuntarily end your cycle. This just led to a stressful experience. Young family members especially struggled, and got frustrated. Not a relaxing or easy game at all. Overall, this is an unexpectedly difficult incremental game with a large barrier to entry. Possibly the rest of the game is good; I wouldn't know because I can't afford many upgrades.
Not as good as Scritchy Scratchy, the gameplay loop doesnt get changed at all and, and theres no intresting upgrades or anything else interesting really
Good but too short, felt like I completed the game in less than 2 hours, have never seen an afk type game with so few meaningful skill upgrades, the tree fits on one screen zoomed in
看似是个增量小游戏，其实是抛硬币模拟器
练枪软件有没有懂的。 差不多三小时就能通关，而且在三周目，还没解锁全部局外的情况下，强度就够通关了，比起别的六七周目才能通关的增量游戏来说，这游戏算快的了。 十几块钱要什么自行车。

刚出就买来体验了，很有意思的增量游戏，只需要一直砸屏幕上面的小猪获得资金然后还清债务，同时还有局外成长会让每一次重新游玩更加轻松。最开始可能赚钱比较慢，但是到后面会越来越快，满屏幕都是硬币和宝石，只需要目光呆滞地按鼠标然后钱就会源源不断的滚来了！四五个小时就可以获得全成就也对成就党特别友好。对增量游戏感兴趣的就来体验一下吧，祝你游戏愉快！ [spoiler]孤注一掷是什么，我按一下！ OMG我赚了100万！ 继续孤注一掷，我输了300万😭😭😭 十赌九输,下次不赌了 继续孤注一掷，我输了500万😭😭😭 再按我就是小猪 我输了700万😭😭😭 ...... 我终于知道我为什么欠那么多钱了💔[/spoiler]
带有微量肉鸽元素的增量游戏，操作简单，只需要敲罐子，但是爽感非常足，数不尽的钱币和宝石从罐子里喷涌而出，伴随着存钱罐破碎的清脆响声，简直是视听盛宴，作者太懂增量游戏的爽点了
像麻子抽多了最后的幻觉，其实死在路边了。
好玩爱玩，就是内容有点少，打得快的话，通关了，还能退款，哈哈哈
好玩的，十分的解压~ 敲猪！烧猪~~ 巨大猪！ 流程四小时左右的小品游戏~
通关了，挺好玩的，让我想起我小时候偷我小猪里的钱买暴龙神。
主动增量解压游戏，核心玩法挥动锤子击碎存钱罐获取资金，按时偿还不断递增的账单，内置轻度rogue，多类型锤子道具与技能分支，击碎存钱罐的音效与画面反馈解压效果突出。 流程较短，完整内容数小时便可体验完毕，全成就达成比较简单。 是一款非常不错的甜品游戏。（不要碰抛硬币！不要碰抛硬币！不要碰抛硬币！）
增量+砸罐子，虽有局外成长也能在三轮以内通关，爽！
甜品级的增量小游戏，就这个敲钱罐爽，要是后续可以更新其他玩法就好了
好玩 但不耐玩 4小时通关顶天了 戒指一半就能过 最后的大猪叠狂暴秒掉很容易

轻度肉鸽的砸猪猪小游戏，打了一夜玩完，还算有意思。不过加成词条直到最后20%内容才有割草的快感，词条的属性给得都太保守了，锤子的特效也有点少；孤注一掷赌博界面这个概率算法似乎是有点BUG，我打了六周目才通关，这个胜率实际上应该接近50%的游戏，没有一次我的胜率是达到50%的，看了讨论区出现这种问题的似乎不是我一个。 另外那个三选一小游戏出现的意义也非常不明，后面完全看不清而且盲选亏损率这么高，想盈利又得作弊。。
挺好玩的，打碎存钱罐挺爽的，快的话大概两个小时就能全成就通关。
最后快要通关这段巨爽无比，重振+狂暴化的音效无敌了，数值方面有点魔塔式，你缺少玩两次的局外数值不可能凑够通关的钱，不算纯赌博流，而玩了两次第三次局外数值就给到可以直接通关了，另外因为没有流派也没什么深度所以不具备重复游玩的价值。但确实够爽
做的很不错的增量游戏，敲猪猪的感觉很解压， 流程曲线很平滑，4小时3周目可以全成就。
增量小游戏，4.5小时全成就。 敲罐子很爽，猪猪也可爱。 没什么好说的，这种游戏就图个乐，不需要啥游戏性。

【首发凌晨1点01分以19块6入手/第四周期以3小时36分通关/4小时全成就白金】游戏的定位我认为更偏向赌博机，游戏几乎没有策略可言，付账单后给的强化很鸡肋，除了加机制性的其他都不用选，技能树强化看升级造价升，哪些便宜基本就升哪些，优先级有，但不用刻意去选，游戏难度很低，门槛基本没有，也没有很强的肉鸽元素（就是前面的三选一，没有改变游戏性质与流派玩法的，到结束都很难拿几次，你的强化九成多都来自局外和技能树），重开价值基本为0（不是靠操作可以一周期过关的，也不是可以靠经验去选择解锁道具，饰品的价格卡死你的强化选项，都是按阶段的，逃不出制作组设计的道路），这游戏关上后就没有打开的欲望了。前面说了，游戏门槛很低，操作空间很有限，而游戏的乐趣更多是通过“爆金币”的视觉享受和“砸碎储钱罐”的破坏欲、老虎机的音效（一个道具和超级头奖的音效）、金币雨的天上撒币，这些元素组成，“冲击波”和“陨石”、“火锤”、“圣光轨道炮”等则差点意思...以及一些道具也不太行（“章鱼哥房子”和“弹珠陀螺”），整个游戏还是比较“半成品”的，许多设计我认为还是缺考虑（那绿色储钱罐的换位速度当真是要玩家盯死吗？那速度都快出残影了，不录屏慢放就只能赌那三分之一了，制作组玩过自己游戏吗？？？），游戏里金币效果的“*4”的触发，储钱罐的四种阶梯奖励，储钱罐升级提升5%金币，但升级又非常非常苛刻，储钱罐之间的价值差又很多很多倍，导致追着一种储钱罐打是非常不明智，也没有强化与储钱罐特性，于是【追着桌子上最值钱的储钱罐锤就好】成了玩家唯一的打法，低种类的储钱罐头奖*4都很不够看，数值膨胀太厉害了，从几十到几十万、几百万，差额太大了...游戏上手门槛特别低，就是【扔掉脑袋】享受循环就好，感受“赛博老虎机”和“赛博柏青哥”的体验就行。游戏里还有压上那把100%经济去博翻倍的抛硬币（如果有拿到强化，可以保底返现15%，以及多获得20%的强化、赌输了下次成功几率加100%，也就是三分之二），如果输了，刚刚赚的全没，【操作和策略不重要，运气才是极大程度决定你的收益多少的决定性因素】所以我个人不是很乐意把这一款游戏称之为“游戏”。这一款游戏的乐趣来源是非常原始与低级，就是人的破坏欲、爆金币的意象表象（看一大堆钱发出悦耳的声音谁能不乐？）、视觉刺激（钱在飞舞与爆炸）、赌博机的音效，整个...就像是“赛博老虎机”，没有策略、研究、操作空间、成长的成分在，路线规划也因为“升级造价”而非“技能点”倒是路线基本没得选，自由度就显得很低很低...游戏其实不是很休闲，还是比较累人的，要求你聚精会神，关闭游戏后疲惫感会涌上来，以上就是我对这游戏的基本评价，应该没有说漏的点，整个游戏就是“博概率”与“享受不确定性”，你的操作和策略都不重要，运气最重要。虽然便宜，才20块钱不到，但以【愿不愿意推荐给自己身边的朋友】为标准，我还是选择【不推荐】。游戏有创意，算是佳作，不平庸，但游戏性质决定了上限，销量估计不会差，但大伙对游戏的口碑与评价不会太高，我认为会是这样。
虽然肉鸽烂大街，但是这游戏该做成肉鸽的，目前因为肉鸽元素少的缘故，重玩价值非常低，砸罐子也就爽一会，通关后就没有点开的欲望跟必要了，非常非常小品级的游戏

快的话三小时左右通关，紧接着就全成就。顶多再体验一下最后一次升满的转生，打完一整轮，游戏就结束了。 [h3] 作为街机增量，这款游戏做对了什么 [/h3] 精巧的系统设计。局间没有冗余繁琐的操作，直接开玩。 将技巧瞄准玩法发挥到了极致。局内玩家始终在进行不费脑的高密度微决策，并收获与之相称的正反馈，整个过程没有停下来过。 基于物理引擎的反馈提供足够的替视听爽感。 [h3] 一些设计上的亮点 [/h3] 贷款机制与账单系统结合得很好，活用贷款能带来相当可观的收益。 用账单、新存钱罐和存钱罐升级代替常见的关卡制，在带来更新颖体验的同时，也让难度曲线更省心，玩家只需要考虑是否提前还款，没有什么管理关卡的操作。 账单系统还给转生机制带来了新花样，玩家可以自由选择转生时机。 BD机制堆料：一般来说，在肉鸽、刷宝类游戏中，强行设计凑数BD是个大忌，但街机增量游戏反而需要以此撑起游戏内容。游戏在这一点上做得很好，为一个简单的挥锤动作设计了许多事件触发器和相关机制。 [h3] 体验上的瑕疵或遗憾 [/h3] 开局有那么几分钟不够得劲，熬过去之后才开始爽。 独特的关卡机制也带来了一些节奏上的问题。如果玩家倾向于主动转生，那么每次转生后获得的加速追赶效果都很有限，跳关速度没有其它增量那么快。甚至很多时候，即使你很久都没转生了，但只要打得动，最优解依旧是拖到后面的阶段再转生，否则反而会拖慢通关速度。吃过两次亏以后，主动转生反而成了一种惩罚，使得中期有一段的体验略显平淡。 每次还清账单后，都会获得一次升级卡片三选一的机会，偶尔也能凑出一些其他BD，但总体来说还是不够得劲。其中有不少凑数的低数值卡，也有许多难以形成联动的机制，真正能够组合成BD的只剩少数。并且，由于转生时购买的永久加成，以及局间购买的大锤强化，都会随着阶段变化而呈现出明显的BD倾向，所以大多数时候，玩家只是按照当前阶段被分配到的BD倾向来选择升级卡片。 因此，这款游戏在BD上的尝试只能算浅尝辄止，略显遗憾。如果这部分能进一步改进，赋予转生更多自由度，并更精心地设计升级卡片，让每一世都有更多机会打造出一些小BD，应该会有趣得多。 [h3] 推荐 [/h3] 总的来说，如果你已经彻底厌倦了整个街机增量赛道，那么这款游戏可以跳过。 但如果你只是厌倦了公式化的增量设计，而仍愿意体验或研究这一赛道中有所创新、尝试破局的优秀作品，那么这款游戏值得一试。

This is my honest review, and it's not a good one on the players to begin with. The game is very underwhelming, and I don't know why people bandwagon on the positive reviews, making this game 'Overwhelmingly Positive' for no special reason. Short game. I completed the game in 6 hrs, but it could definitely be completed in 4 or 5 hrs. People keep saying that's good for the price it asks. WTH? Have you guys really stopped valuing your money? It was an easy one from start to end. Even the final boss only needed a second try. If I could, I'd ask for my money back. You go from slow smash to insanity smash and done, in just 3 runs. After that, it's more like choosing the right path and right moment to upgrade each smash session. And even if you choose wrong and go bankrupt, in the next run that mistake can be repeated without any consequences. The mini-game and bet system are pointless. Why in hell would I bet my earnings to double my money, but if I lose I'd lose everything, when the game is so damn short? If only I could get something else out of that situation, like if I lost, getting a "consolation prize". I only used that 'option' a couple of times when I had already lost the run to try my luck at continuing a little longer. And it was a 'yes' or 'no', and nothing else from that. Talking about it might not have the same weight as seeing the system for yourself, but it is completely useless. And there is a mini-game, a "shell game", where you bet your money and it feels more like a joke. It shuffles the piggies but it makes it impossible for you to follow, and you have to rely again on luck. Same as the first, no point in using that. Relics are just something you have on the table that helps the game be even easier, and I just got them in bulk on my second run. Not even the achievements are anything special. All very easy to accomplish and didn't made me keep the game installed to try past the first time I finished the game. But well, some people think that's an OVERWHELMINGLY POSITIVE thing from a game. The only good thing about this game is how satisfying it is to smash the piggy banks, it really is. The sound and how they break really kept my brain massaged. That's it. After having finished the game, not even that feeling would make me go back to playing this since I have nowhere new to go.

This game sucks, and for all the reasons games like this suck. Games where players are forced to repeatedly play the same content over and over again with the illusion of "progress" is one of the laziest forms of game development. It's borderline infuriating, especially when gambling mechanics are introduced that can literally make or break your playthrough. Gambling mechanics that, mind you, aren't even worth using (the coin flip, for instance), because you lose far more often than you ever win, despite it being a flippin' coin flip. I couldn't recommend against this game less and I hope this review helps at least one person avoid wasting their money.
